name: reellingo
description: Run the ReelLingo backend and website together on your computer.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
